description: Philosophy of mind decomposed. Higher-order theories (HOT, HOP), integrated information theory (IIT), global workspace theory, attention schema theory, representationalism (Tye, Dretske), enactivism, predictive processing, panpsychism revival.

sub_mechanisms.name: higher_order_thought_theory
sub_mechanisms.definition: Rosenthal: state conscious iff subject has thought about that state.
sub_mechanisms.why: Reductive theory of consciousness. State is conscious because awareness of it. Cost: regress, unconscious thoughts about states.

sub_mechanisms.name: integrated_information_theory
sub_mechanisms.definition: Tononi: consciousness = integrated information (Φ). Mathematical measure.
sub_mechanisms.why: Quantitative theory. Predicts what systems are conscious. Cost: panpsychist implications, computational intractability.

sub_mechanisms.name: global_workspace_theory
sub_mechanisms.definition: Baars: consciousness = broadcast of info to global workspace. Bottleneck for accessibility.
sub_mechanisms.why: Cognitive science theory. Predicts neural correlates. Influential in AI consciousness debate.

sub_mechanisms.name: attention_schema_theory
sub_mechanisms.definition: Graziano: consciousness is brain's internal model of its own attention.
sub_mechanisms.why: Recent theory. Makes consciousness functional + evolutionarily explicable. Doesn't address hard problem directly.

sub_mechanisms.name: representationalism_qualia
sub_mechanisms.definition: Qualia identical to representational content. Tye, Dretske.
sub_mechanisms.why: Reduces phenomenal to intentional. Vehicles + contents. Influential within physicalism.

sub_mechanisms.name: enactivism
sub_mechanisms.definition: Cognition = embodied action in world (Varela, Thompson). Brain not enough.
sub_mechanisms.why: Influence: 4E cognition (embodied, embedded, extended, enacted). Substrate's sensorimotor loops align.

sub_mechanisms.name: predictive_processing
sub_mechanisms.definition: Brain as prediction machine. Friston: minimise prediction error.
sub_mechanisms.why: Unifying framework. Free energy principle. Active inference. Influence: AI architectures.

sub_mechanisms.name: panpsychism_revival
sub_mechanisms.definition: Consciousness fundamental + ubiquitous. Strawson, Chalmers, Goff.
sub_mechanisms.why: Response to hard problem: avoid emergence by making consciousness fundamental. Cost: combination problem (how small minds combine).

sub_mechanisms.name: anomalous_monism
sub_mechanisms.definition: Davidson: mental + physical events identical, but no psychophysical laws.
sub_mechanisms.why: Token identity without type identity. Allows mental causation. Critics: epiphenomenalism worry.

sub_mechanisms.name: epiphenomenalism
sub_mechanisms.definition: Mental states caused by physical but causally inert.
sub_mechanisms.why: Avoids interaction problem of dualism. Cost: how do mental states get into beliefs about them?

sub_mechanisms.name: type_token_identity
sub_mechanisms.definition: Type identity: pain = C-fibers firing always. Token: this pain = this C-firing.
sub_mechanisms.why: Multiple realisability refutes type identity. Token identity weaker, survives.

sub_mechanisms.name: biological_naturalism_Searle
sub_mechanisms.definition: Consciousness is biological feature, like digestion. Not computation.
sub_mechanisms.why: Searle. Anti-computational. Specific physical realisation matters. Substrate's response: structure matters more than substance.

derivation_rules.name: IIT_quantifies_consciousness_with_caveats
then: Φ measures integrated information; high Φ = more consciousness
derivation_rules.why: Predictive: photodiode (low Φ) not conscious; brain (high Φ) is. Cost: computational intractability + panpsychist implications.

derivation_rules.name: panpsychism_solves_hard_problem_creates_combination
derivation_rules.why: How do micro-experiences combine into unified macro-experience? New problem of equal difficulty. Trade.

derivation_rules.name: predictive_processing_unifying_framework
derivation_rules.why: Friston's free energy. Wide explanatory scope. Influence on AI: active inference architectures.

derivation_rules.name: enactivism_grounds_cognition_in_action
then: brain alone insufficient; body + environment essential
derivation_rules.why: Varela + Thompson. Skull-bound mind rejected. Substrate's sensorimotor cortex aligns. 4E cognition mainstream now.

derivation_rules.name: biological_naturalism_substrate_specific
derivation_rules.why: Functionalism rejected. Substrate's response: structural reasoning isn't a consciousness claim — structure (and authoring) is what's important, not substrate.
